answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond and pass a unique cipher challenge tied to its public key before it can claim nectar rewards at the shared jetty of the marketplace: the bond is slashed if the same work is submitted twice, and reputation accrues slowly, one verified job at a time. A Sybil attacker must therefore fund and age thousands of separate bonds, while honest agents reuse one seasoned identity, so faking scale costs real capital and time instead of free copies.
